name: lede
label: Lede
default: Every serious tool in this category is sold to HR — bought by People teams, used by managers as an obligation, and built around the review cycle rather than around Tuesday.

default.title: Built for you as the buyer
default.body: Not for the person HR makes comply. You decide it's worth it, and you're done.

default.title: One surface, not four
default.body: Metrics, skills and behaviours in the same place, rather than stitched together from tools that were never meant to meet.

default.title: Judgment, not dashboards
default.body: It tells you what to do about what it shows you — before the conversation, not after the quarter.
